name: Bricking
definition: A method to handle volumetric data larger than GPU memory by dividing the original volume into smaller sub-volumes (bricks) that fit into GPU memory, rendering them individually, and composing the final image from these sub-images.
summary: Bricking partitions large volumetric datasets into fixed-size 3D blocks to fit GPU memory, differing from chunk-based structures by using uniform blocks and from tile-based methods by operating on 3D spatial subdivisions.
